blocks.content: The Ministry of Coal released AAROH: Annual Report on Mine Closure in New Delhi on 23 July 2026. The report is India’s first comprehensive documentation on scientific mine closure and repurposing practices and covers 42 scientifically closed coal mines across the country.

items: India has scientifically closed 42 coal mines, including 33 mines in the last year.
The target is to scientifically close 147 more mines within the next two to three years.
RECLAIM, SUVIKALP, and ARTHA are key terms linked with India’s mine closure framework.
Coal Neer plants use mine water for bottled drinking water production.
